description: This file defines a set of wrapper functions and interfaces for intercepting and extending the behavior of http.ResponseWriter and related interfaces in Go, specifically for use with the httpsnoop package. It includes a Wrap function that adds hooks for various HTTP response methods.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: A struct containing function hooks for intercepting methods of http.ResponseWriter and related interfaces.

classes.name: rw
classes.description: A wrapper struct implementing http.ResponseWriter and other interfaces, allowing hooks to modify behavior.

classes.name: Unwrapper
classes.description: An interface with a method to retrieve the underlying http.ResponseWriter from wrapped layers.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: Returns a wrapped version of an http.ResponseWriter that applies specified hooks to its methods.

methods.name: Unwrap
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the original http.ResponseWriter from wrapped layers.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Method of rw that returns the header map, possibly modified by hooks.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Method of rw that writes HTTP headers, possibly intercepted by hooks.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Method of rw that writes response body, possibly intercepted by hooks.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Method of rw that flushes buffered data, possibly intercepted by hooks.

methods.name: CloseNotify
methods.description: Method of rw that returns a channel notifying when the connection is closed, possibly intercepted by hooks.

methods.name: Hijack
methods.description: Method of rw that hijacks the connection, possibly intercepted by hooks.

methods.name: ReadFrom
methods.description: Method of rw that reads data from an io.Reader, possibly intercepted by hooks.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Method of rw that initiates server push, possibly intercepted by hooks.
